definitions.explanation: A closed plane figure with three or more straight sides.

examples.japanese: {三角形|さんかくけい}も{四角形|しかくけい}も{多角形|たかくけい}の{一種|いっしゅ}だ。
examples.english: Both triangles and quadrilaterals are types of polygons.

examples.japanese: {正|せい}{多角形|たかくけい}は{全|すべ}ての{辺|へん}と{角|かく}が{等|ひと}しい。
examples.english: A regular polygon has all sides and angles equal.

examples.japanese: {六角形|ろっかくけい}は{六|むっ}つの{辺|へん}を{持|も}つ{多角形|たかくけい}だ。
examples.english: A hexagon is a polygon with six sides.

notes:
{多角形|たかくけい} is the general mathematical term for any polygon. Composed of {多|た} (many) + {角|かく} (angle/corner) + {形|けい} (shape).

COMMON POLYGONS:
- {三角形|さんかくけい}: triangle (3 sides)
- {四角形|しかくけい}: quadrilateral (4 sides)
- {五角形|ごかくけい}: pentagon (5 sides)
- {六角形|ろっかくけい}: hexagon (6 sides)
- {八角形|はちかくけい}: octagon (8 sides)

RELATED TERMS:
- {正|せい}{多角形|たかくけい}: regular polygon (all sides and angles equal)
- {辺|へん}: side (of a polygon)
- {頂点|ちょうてん}: vertex
- {内角|ないかく}: interior angle
- {対角線|たいかくせん}: diagonal

PATTERN:
The suffix 〜{角形|かくけい} is productive: number + {角形|かくけい} forms any polygon name.
